BOARD_DOC: Detected Raspberry Pi family and firmware revision. Detection is waveshare28-config detect.
PANEL_LIVE_DOC: Live backend device. If the firmware overlay is not on this boot yet, this says a reboot is required.
KMS3A_DOC: Read-only. The configurator writes this board's revision filter only when it is missing from volumioconfig.txt. Not a user switch.
ROTATION_DOC: Degrees clockwise. fbtft rotate is the counter-clockwise equivalent. The usual landscape mount is 270.
SPEED_DOC: SPI clock. Also the fbtft speed when backend is framebuffer. 32000000 is the reference.
BACKEND_DOC: spi: renderer owns the bus. framebuffer: fbtft stays for Plymouth, renderer mmaps the panel framebuffer.
CONSOLE_DOC: Framebuffer only. release unbinds fbcon so kernel text cannot overwrite the player. share leaves fbcon bound.
HDMI_DOC: Pi 4 family and framebuffer only. Off cancels Volumio's hdmi_force_hotplug so Plymouth can bind this panel. On keeps HDMI for audio or a monitor.
VERIFY_DOC: Compare derived files against /boot/waveshare28.conf without changing anything.
SECTION_BACKUP_CREATE_DESC: Save the current panel keys on this device. The restore list updates on this page. A name that already exists is overwritten.
BACKUP_NAME_DOC: 1 to 64 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens.
SECTION_BACKUP_RESTORE_DESC: Apply a named backup through the same checks as Apply. Only rotation, speed, backend, console and hdmi are restored.
BACKUP_SELECTED_DOC: Named backups live under /data/INTERNAL/waveshare28/backups and survive plugin uninstall.
SECTION_BACKUP_DELETE_DESC: Remove a named backup from this device. Live settings are not changed.
